summary: Nationality/career driver-info loader operating on the F1CVehicle driver region. For driver index a2, it indexes the nationality data array (dword_8AC394 + 1060 * a2), sets the driver full name via SetDriverName from the entry, fills the 23-byte nationality string buffer at this + 18016 (defaulting to byte_5EA438 and, when AudioChannelStop(this + 17952) succeeds, to the aNationality data entry via StringKeyedLinkedListSearch + DataEntryAccessor), copies the short description (this + 18040) and long description (this + 18104), sets the abbreviation code via ShortStringSet, copies the nationality flag path into this + 18196, and stores the driver index at this + 18584. Returns the ShortStringSet result.
